notes: Synthetic: from Together's OpenAPI spec as embedded in its official SDK, github.com/togethercomputer/together-py scripts/mock at 3428f80887121c5715f670f3cffa71b2ed482c12 (2026-10-28; pinned as contractspec/subsets/together), POST /v1/audio/speech: AudioSpeechRequest (model canopylabs/orpheus-3b-0.1-ft, its example; voice tara, the voice its description names for that model; response_format mp3) and the 200 answer, audio/mpeg among the content types it lists, which CreateSpeech passes through. response.bin is the suite's ID3 header and MPEG frame headers (see gpt-4o-mini-tts-2025-12-15), not real audio. Not covered: the text/event-stream answer to stream true (AudioSpeechStreamResponse), which models.SpeechRequest has no field to ask for. Error cases: the operation's 4xx answers are ErrorData ({error: {message, type, param, code}}), whose type and code are free strings; their values are the ones the same spec documents for Together's errors: the error categories of the queue endpoints' QueueError ("invalid_request_error", "not_found_error") and the error codes of its realtime endpoints (invalid_api_key "Invalid API key provided (401)", model_not_available "Invalid or unavailable model (400)"), each message being its code's documented description. docs.together.ai was not reachable from the authoring sandbox.
